purpose: Express relief that a long-awaited result finally occurred.
keywords: give explain a reason cause result
After practicing many times, I finally learned to swim.
restrictions: Usually highlights effort, delay, or waiting.
mistake: It does not fit every neutral occurrence of finally in a chronological list.
